Here are our top 5 fights of 2025 - what do you think?
In a back and forth 3 round bout, undefeated lightweight prospect Justin Gaethje (8-0) takes on MMA veteran Brian Cobb (20-7) at WSOF 3, 2013.

In the WSOFNYC main event, undefeated lightweight kingpin Justin The Highlight Gaethje (16-0) defends his crown against Luiz Buscape Firmino (19-7). WSOFNYC featured an unprecedented New Years Eve world championship extravaganza at The Theater at Madison Square Garden in New York City.
In the lightweight championship main event, undefeated champ Justin Gaethje (15-0) attempts to defend his throne against Brian Foster (26-8) at WSOF 29, 2016.

In the peoples main event, undefeated contedner and fan favorite Justin Gaethje (12-0) takes on Melvin Guillard (32-13-2) in a catchweight bout at WSOF 15, 2014. The hostility between the two fighters during fight week made this the most anticipated bout of the weekend.
In his third fight in the WSOF, undefeated knockout artist Justin Gaethje (9-0) accepts the challenge from MMA veteran Dan Lauzon (17-4) at WSOF 6, 2013.
The first ever WSOF lightweight king Justin Gaethje (11-0) attempts his first title defense against undefeated contender Nick Newell (11-0) at WSOF 11, 2014.

In what many consider one of the best fights in the history of WSOF, and the Fight of the Year for 2015, lightweight champ Justin Gaethje (13-0) faces Luis Palomino (23-9) in an epic battle. Gaethje vs Palomino in the main event of WSOF 19, 2015.

In a rematch of one of the best fights in WSOF history, undefeated lightweight champ Justin Gaethje (14-0) attempts to defend his belt against Luis Palomino (23-10) for the second time. Gaethje vs Palomino 2 in the main event of WSOF 23, 2015.
PFL Austin featured Johnny Eblen vs. Impa Kasanganay for the interim middleweight title in the main event, plus Lewis McGrillen vs. Rafael do Nascimento in a bantamweight co-main event.

PFL Washington D.C. featured Thad Jean vs. late replacement Ernesto Rodriguez for the vacant welterweight title in the main event, plus Tyson Pedro vs. Rafael Xavier in the light heavyweight co-main event.

PFL San Diego featured California standout AJ McKee vs. undefeated Salamat Isbulaev in the featherweight main event, plus former PFL champion Liz Carmouche taking on Viviane Araujo in the co-main event.
PFL MENA 10 in Riyadh featured Saudi star Hattan Alsaif vs. Dania Ouhachi in the catchweight main event, plus Hazem Kayyali vs. Hassan Shaaban in a welterweight tournament showdown.
Cris Cyborg faces Ketlen Vieira, while Gadzhi Rabadanov takes on Tracy Reeder in Tampa.
Usman Nurmagomedov battles Archie Colgan, with Dakota Ditcheva also in action in New York.
Relive PFL MENA 11 in 60 minutes, featuring Mostafa Rashed Nada vs. Osama ElSeady in Riyadh.
Relive PFL Chicago in 60 minutes, featuring Liz Carmouche vs. Jena Bishop and Timur Khizriev vs. Gabriel Braga.
Relive PFL Africa 3 in 60 minutes, featuring Abdoulaye Kane vs. Badr Medkouri in Casablanca, Morocco.
Go back to school with a collection of exciting PFL fights, big moments, and wild finishes.
